independentInterpretation.identity: A blue-painted old hull frame with dark metal ribs, plates and small rivets. The edge variant has an exposed tilted broken sheet projecting from the middle front. The native object is an open frame, although the S sprite overlaps rails into a visually full blue panel.
independentInterpretation.original: Strong flat electric blue planes and abrupt navy shading read as simple extruded slabs. Small fasteners and darker framing carry identity but little rounded volume or material richness. The frontal broken sheet is blunt and dark.
independentInterpretation.target: The fixed target shows thick, rounded blue hull pieces, controlled woodlike directional variation, softened worn gold edge highlights, dark rounded iron bracing and readable pale fasteners. A broad dark exposed plate gives the edge variant a purposeful distinction. Useful improvements are softened volume, crafted construction and legible blue/metal separation. The target includes more solid infill than the actual open-frame source; this is not permission to overwrite required port profiles or fill legitimate rail openings.
independentInterpretation.styleReference: Plant reference uses clean broad faceted volumes, saturated but legible color, gentle warm highlights and a dark-to-light volume hierarchy. Translate this softness and material clarity without importing plant shapes or the reference palette.
independentInterpretation.modelingFreedom: Reward improved native forms, proportions, construction and purposeful decoration. The original part count, flat box geometry and sparse surface finish are not aesthetic requirements.
independentInterpretation.viewLimits: Only the original S snapshot and fixed target establish pictured visual intent. Native four views and connections must be judged later for coherent construction; no unseen target views are invented.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: The blue hull and darker braces have soft rounded readable volume, with a purposeful exposed/broken-sheet edge identity that remains clear at a128-logical-cell and phone32-cell view.
Warm broad edge light and blue midtones separate the worn hull from dark iron and pale rivets. Avoid black dead surfaces, bright yellow striping and photographic microtexture.

The true open framing and negative spaces remain clean; connecting rails meet visibly and functionally with no cracks, steps, dark patches or color collars. Decoration enriches nonfunctional interior surfaces without overwhelming the silhouette.
